scientific_question: Does a frozen OpenEvo SD-LoRA adapter trained on H1.29 self-generated successes transfer to a fresh WebShop task panel under the same frozen base-model evaluation contract?
hypothesis: If the H1.29 adapter captured task-general action behavior rather than only its acquisition tasks, the adapter arm will improve paired fresh-task score or execution quality over BASE; otherwise the result will distinguish task-specific fitting from transfer failure.

panel.task_use: consumed by H1.32 only; do not later reuse it as H1.30 formal evaluation

arms.H129_SELF_ADAPTER: the exact H1.29 rank-4 OpenEvo SD-LoRA adapter, loaded without further training or modification

frozen_contract.invalid_attempt_policy: retain parser/runtime/identity failures; exclude them from valid-score denominators and report separately

adapter_identity.load_policy: local_files_only; verify adapter config, state manifest, component count, base revision, and reload evidence before launch

secondary: median valid episode wall time seconds
metrics.positive_rule: H129_SELF_ADAPTER has a positive paired mean task_score and does not worsen invalid-attempt rate by more than 5 percentage points; this remains a transfer diagnostic, not a general OpenEvo efficacy claim.
metrics.negative_rule: Non-positive paired score or task-local improvement classifies the adapter as no demonstrated fresh-task transfer; do not sweep H1.29 hyperparameters under this experiment.

resource_budget.parallel_policy: one UUID-bound container per task cell; BASE and adapter waves are disjoint; verify release after each wave

tracking.offline_fallback: only after recorded online initialization failure and spool hash

required_gates: CPU tests, preflight, and manifest hash verification pass
H1.29 adapter files and reload evidence match every recorded digest
eight authorized UUIDs are idle immediately before each wave
all output cells preserve task/seed/arm identity and local Run Manifest receipts
all GPUs are idle after each wave
claim_boundary: This is a fresh-task transfer diagnostic for one frozen H1.29 adapter. It makes no SEED comparison, no teacher claim, no Q3 generalization claim, and no claim about a new adapter or hyperparameter sweep.
